title: Atom-type-free transferable LINK-XTB primitive-Hessian correction
summary: Fit a positive a-priori primitive-Hessian correction from coordinate families and continuous same-state LINK-XTB observables only.
coordinate_policy: Transform both harmonic Hessians on the same complete frozen R/A/L/SOOP/D primitive pool supplied by SMITH; experimental fundamentals are forbidden as targets. Inspect increasing factor counts once and stop at the first registered validation plateau.
backend_policy: The frozen model uses only primitive family, geometric-mean Mayer bond order and mean absolute SCC charge from the same LINK-XTB state. Atom types, element-pair tables and external-QM populations are forbidden. Every off-diagonal factor is the geometric mean of its diagonal factors. Apply the frozen coefficients a priori to a new LINK-XTB Hessian without a reference Hessian, molecule-specific fitting or categorical lookup.
